invariants.prerequisites: Python >=3.11 and Git; no unattended system installation
invariants.sims_executable: Game/Bin/TS4_x64.exe or TS4.exe in known locations or explicitly selected path
invariants.game_launch: deliberate double-click/explicit CLI auto invocation or manual chooser click; no background auto launch; subprocess without shell
invariants.save_selection: player-only until separately verified authorized save identity + calibrated local scene/action gating; never blind Resume or auto-select unknown saves
invariants.protected_data: never read/write user saves or edit Sims game files
invariants.host_proof: process dispatch is not game load or Live Mode evidence
invariants.active_process: read-only bounded tasklist PID observation; if Sims already running, never launch a second copy; dispatch PID is not necessarily the actual game PID
invariants.menu_learning: NOT_OBSERVED unless future host captures independently certify scene/menu cues; no speculative detection or automatic menu clicks

limitations: Read-only bounded default install discovery may require manual path selection
Existing game-host image-template navigator is independent and requires separately observed calibrated screenshots and strict screen lease
Gameplay and saved-session observations require an authorized Windows P08 run
Unique-install Windows auto-launch is not automatic loading of the latest protected user save; save identity and scene-safe navigation require dedicated local proof
